description: This file defines a PHP class `Subscription` that extends Opencart's Controller class, providing functionalities for managing subscription reports in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, viewing, and saving subscription configurations.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription reports in the admin area of OpenCart, providing methods for listing, viewing, and saving subscription-related data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the subscription report form, initializing language and document title, setting breadcrumbs, and rendering the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of subscription configuration settings. Checks permissions, updates settings via model, and outputs JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates the subscription report page, loading report data, subscription statuses, and preparing pagination and filters.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the subscription report list view with current report data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves filtered subscription report data based on request parameters, formats data for display, and handles pagination.
